review: Manual reading of every registration and invoked helper in the five source runtime files; comparison with actual target bodies, not title similarity. Sections supply source/target paths and default predicates/lane to their rows. Expansion objects are individual source cases. Target keys resolve to the exact path/title below. No execution credit is inferred from authored coverage.
frameworkAdaptations: Owned JSX factories/live renderProps replace React rerender and act. Existing source act/flush helpers express scheduling, not required Solid APIs.
Render callbacks expose live state rather than repeated React component invocation. DOM state reads establish committed state, not automatically the first source render observation.

Native class and ref arrays replace className and element cloning. Defaultless Solid contexts throw a framework error; provider-error tests preserve rejection intent but not React's exact Base UI message.
Solid Loading/held updates replace React 19 Suspense/use; the target does not assert the visible loading fallback, so that source case remains partial.
Geometry mocks and pure arithmetic tests cannot qualify real layout, RTL browser navigation, native ResizeObserver delivery or hydration. Browser rows retain their browser lane.
